[[Image:Menethil Harbor.jpg|thumb|Menethil Harbor]]
[[Menethil Harbor]] is a port [[town]] on the western shore of the [[Wetlands]]. It has a [[boat]] that sails to [[Auberdine]] in [[Darkshore]] and another that sails to [[Theramore Isle]] in [[Dustwallow Marsh]]. Both locations are on the continent of [[Kalimdor]]. Within the city are many [[vendor]]s, a [[First Aid Trainer]], the [[Deepwater Tavern]], and a [[Gryphon]] [[Flight Master]].

==History==
Menethil Harbor, named after the ruling dynasty of Lordaeron, was originally established at the end of the [[Second War]] as the main sea link between [[Khaz Modan]] and the kingdoms of [[Lordaeron]], [[Dalaran]], [[Stromgarde]], [[Gilneas]], and [[Kul Tiras]]. It is the only stationary Alliance presence in the Wetlands, a small well-fortified city that numbers a little over ten thousand souls. Murlock and pirate incursions are a constant threat.

With the fall of Lordaeron, and the end of the [[Third War]], Menethil Harbor still serves a critical purpose as it serves as the main hub of Alliance naval routes between the old kingdoms of [[Khaz Modan]] and [[Stormwind]], and their new allies at [[Theramore Isle]] and [[Teldrassil]].
